measures.formulaText:
📝 SHOW YOUR WORK (NO-DRAG IDEAL)

h₀ is launch height above ground; landing is y = 0. Initial horizontal velocity is vx₀ = v cos(θ), and initial vertical velocity is vy₀ = v sin(θ).

Flight Time:
T = (vy₀ + √(vy₀² + 2gh₀)) / g
= (0.00 + √(0.00² + 2 × 9.8 × 10)) / 9.8
= 1.43 s
Range:
R = vx₀ × T
= 15.00 × 1.429
= 21.43 m
Max height above ground:
H = h₀ + vy₀² / (2g)
= 10 + 0.00² / (2 × 9.8)
= 10.00 m
